title: From Optimization to Satisficing: Robust Screening under Distributional Ambiguity
summary: This study investigates a robust screening problem under distributional ambiguity, where a seller is uncertain about a buyer's true valuation distribution, knowing only that it lies near a reference distribution measured by the Wasserstein metric. Traditional robust optimization (RO) approaches prioritize maximizing worst-case revenue within predefined ambiguity sets, often yielding seller-centric outcomes and reliance on precise set specifications.
